nodes.label: Rundale-Bench Public Reproducible Benchmark
nodes.description: In-progress header plan promotes ad-hoc probes into a frozen benchmark with versioned datasets, held-out splits, hybrid graders, a pinned judge, cost/latency reporting, and an append-only leaderboard.
nodes.status: header says in progress; body status section says proposed

nodes.label: Five Inference-Category Benchmark Slices
nodes.description: Intent, reaction, Tier 2 simulation, Tier 3 simulation, and dialogue slices use deterministic, hybrid, or pinned-judge grading appropriate to their output contracts.

nodes.label: Holdout and Judge-Drift Controls
nodes.description: A sealed 20 percent holdout, Merkle roots, SemVer freezes, runtime rubric hashes, regression prompts, and reproducibility tolerance constrain contamination and silent judge drift.

edges.description: The five slices define the benchmark's task surface.
Contamination and judge instability motivate the benchmark's freeze and validation controls.
Rundale-bench is presented as the public reproducible face of the earlier in-repo quality sensor effort.
